requiredKindsRule: manifest.requiredKinds is the sorted (code-unit order), de-duplicated list of the catalog families this cut's root requires: its complete families only, partial ones excluded by the engine. The same list is the requiredKinds of the cut's families/families registry component, inside the content checkpointDigest covers.
clientRules: Read requiredKinds verbatim; never derive it from a built-in family list.
A manifest without requiredKinds (an older engine) is refused as manifest_missing_required_kinds, never opened from a built-in list.
A kind the client does not know is refused as manifest_unknown_required_kind, never ignored.
normalization: Random epoch ids become 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<n> and every 64-hex digest a stable alias, in order of first appearance; every other byte is the engine's.
regenerate: SENPI_WRITE_RECOVERY_GOLDENS=1 npx vitest run test/suite/regressions/5397-required-kinds-golden.test.ts (packages/coding-agent, senpi repository)
